$Comment: Martha's Favorite: collect a Feast Basket, which Martha packs each time a player's favor with her
climbs another step past Head of the Table (Beyond in Reputations/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Host.json,
the table Lootables/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Feast_Basket.json). The basket is collected on the
Reputation page, and its items come to the player as a payout labelled
reputation:Harvest_Feast_Host, which nothing else pays through. LOOT_RECEIVED counts every item a
payout hands over, Qualifier its label, so this criterion names that label and no Target (any item
counts) and a change to what the basket holds needs no edit here. The criterion's TextKey words the
Earned once and kept, after Head of the Table: no Parent, so no yearly copy, and no full_table tag.
Its gift waits in Rewards.Claim on the achievements page: Harvest Coins, and MMO Skill Tree's
Mmo_Boost_Token, half again as much XP in every skill for an hour, which the player starts when it
suits them. The token row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server
without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the coins still pay. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the
id harvest_feast_marthas_favorite, and its words come from the keys that id spells.
